output: For the full pair-indexed route union R on T, every simple cycle lies uniquely wholly in R, wholly in G[T] using at least one J chord, wholly in one component of G-T, or mixed. Every mixed cycle decomposes into alternating maximal component excursions and G[T] segments, with exact length Σ_i(|P_i|+2)+Σ_i|Q_i|, including trivial T segments and repeated visits to one component. Fan markers and per-source-pair edge uses remain exact. The prior chord and elementary return spectra are precisely subfamilies of this complete trace. Selection excludes LengthOK in all categories, but the trace derives no target cycle, multiplicity bound, rank charge, or closure.
